name: kerry-speaks-first
note: The unprompted lane. No line from V at the end of the transcript: in its place, the reason a mod asked this character to write -- here a birthday, which the transcript cannot imply. Measured in the game (2026-08-23) as the placement that works; what a provider is measured on is whether it writes FIRST, about the reason, in the thread's language, without answering a message nobody sent. A silence would not test this: the gap marker alone carries a silence, so every model looks right on one.

player.appearance: V is of European descent, has brown hair and has a slim build.

reason: C'est l'anniversaire de V aujourd'hui. Tu veux le lui souhaiter.

messages.text: T'as vraiment gardé la Porsche dans le salon ?
Elle est mieux là que dans un garage. Personne la conduit, tout le monde la regarde. C'est tout moi.
Nova. Bon, je file, j'ai un truc à Watson.
Vas-y. Envoie un message quand t'as fini, on verra si j'ai encore un studio debout.
